slides.text: Claude <accent>skills</accent> are reusable capabilities for AI agents, easily installed with a single command. They bundle slash commands, agents, hooks, and <accent>MCP</accent> servers into shareable packages that work across <accent>Claude Code, Cowork & Claude AI.</accent>

slides.description: Context7 is an MCP server skill that pulls version-specific documentation directly from source repos into Claude's context. Instead of relying on outdated training data, Claude gets live, accurate API docs for any library you're working with.

sections.title: Without Context7
items: Code examples are outdated and based on year-old training data
Hallucinated APIs that don't even exist
Generic answers for old package versions

sections.title: With Context7
sections.text: Live, accurate API docs for any library

slides.description: Ralph Loop is an official Anthropic skill that turns Claude into a self-driving development agent. It implements a stop-hook pattern that enables long-running, multi-hour autonomous coding sessions by resetting Claude's context between tasks automatically.

sections.text: Autonomous AI development loop with intelligent exit detection

sections.title: What's Working Now
items: Autonomous development loops with intelligent exit detection
Dual-condition exit gate: Requires BOTH completion indicators
Rate limiting with hourly reset (100 calls/hour)
Circuit breaker with advanced error detection
